s4.title: 4391 BraveBots | Behind the Bumpers | 2025 FRC REEFSCAPE Robot (auto-caption)

bet.text: Shoot coral onto the reef instead of placing it, from underneath for L4.

cycle.text: A light flashes green when a coral is loaded and turns solid green when an AprilTag is also seen. The robot can then score a shot automatically: it shoots down onto L2 and L3, and onto the pole for L4.

endgame.text: The hopper is raised and a pneumatic climber comes up, knocks down a part the team calls the foot, latches the cage and pulls it down into the robot.

fallback.text: When a coral lies in front of the reef, the robot can shoot over it, even at L4.

gave_up.text: The algae ground intake came off for the second competition to save weight, and returned for the state championship.

changed.text: The algae intake went back on for the state championship with about two pounds to spare. A piece of plastic was added because algae kept falling out. At first the cage came up too high and would have hit a camera, so the climber was designed around that.

outcome.text: 57-14-0 in official play; finalist in the Archimedes division; ranked 17 of the pooled top 20 (OPR 100.54, Archimedes).

solves.text: Score L4 consistently without placing coral from above
